title: Family left 'nauseous' after 'see-through' UFO shines lights into girl's bedroom
excerpt: A family was left feeling sick after a giant, see-through UFO hovered outside their home and beamed bright lights into a 12-year-old girl's bedroom
content:
A family was left feeling sick after a giant, see-through UFO hovered outside their home and beamed bright lights into a 12-year-old girl's bedroom

13:09, 13 Nov 2026Updated 13:09, 13 Nov 2026

A terrified family was left feeling physically sick after a colossal, translucent UFO hovered outside their home and blasted blinding beams into a young girl's bedroom. The bizarre encounter unfolded in Wilsonville, Oregon, US, on August 25 this year and was logged the very same day with the National UFO Reporting Center (NUFORC).

‌

‌

According to the witness, identified only as 'S', the spine-chilling ordeal kicked off around 8pm while she was relaxing on her back patio. She watched in disbelief as a strange, rectangular craft plummeted from the heavens before rapidly morphing into different shapes.

‌

"I noticed what looked like something I've never seen fall out of the sky. Almost like a bird was shot dead in the air and plummeted," S told NUFORC.

Article continues below

"The object went from looking rectangular to a large ball, then a small ball in a matter of a blink. I pointed out to my partner and daughter, 'there's something falling out of the sky.'"

The terrifying close encounter escalated just over an hour later at 9.14pm when S's 12-year-old daughter bolted out of her bedroom after dazzling lights began flashing across her walls.

Rushing in to investigate, the stunned parents discovered a massive, hovering craft suspended right outside the window, beaming its lights straight into the house.

‌

Despite the panic, the quick-thinking youngster managed to snap a photo of the mysterious visitor. "Thankfully, my 12-year-old was able to get a pic of it while it was happening," S said.

The youngster, who spotted the craft first and yelled for her mum and dad, claimed the silent giant was as wide as three passenger planes with its nose angled upwards.

‌

Witness testimony filed to the database noted the eerie craft was "silver in colour with a distorted, see-through surface, two really big lights and no distinct shape."

‌

Speaking to NUFORC investigator Keith Bickford, S added that the plunging object had initially dropped as if "shot out of thin air" before transforming into a "giant ball" trailing a "peculiar" wake.

"It had a stream following behind it what looked like smoke? But not smoke," said S. When the family dashed back into the bedroom, they were met with "this big object floating still pointed directly towards" their property.

‌

"It hovered there for almost a minute and then just disappeared. My daughter was looking at it before she got us and said it looked like it was see-through silver when it got close," the eyewitness said.

‌

The brush with the unknown appeared to take an immediate physical toll on the pair. S revealed she was struck down with "balance issues" and left feeling "nauseous" in the aftermath, while her daughter battled on-and-off headaches all night before both recovered the following morning.

Investigator Bickford confirmed he ruled out conventional aircraft and local agricultural technology, officially branding the case unexplained.

‌

Bickford wrote in the report: "I contacted two farmers with property in the area and both used drones day and night for crop care, but none of the drones were close to the size stated in this report.

"Both the Clackamas County Sheriff's Office and the Wilsonville Police Department had no UAP or UFO reports for that evening. FlightRadar24 showed nothing. I am classifying this as an anomalous sighting."
